# LimePointing works — website source pack

Collected 2026-10-28 from https://www.facebook.com/profile.php?id=61577993745827 by FB Site Grabber.

> **Notes for Claude:** this is raw material scraped from the business's own Facebook page, to build their website from.
> - Contact details, address, hours and prices must be used exactly as written here — never invent or "tidy" them into something different.
> - The posts are in the owner's own voice: use them for tone, the services they actually do, areas they cover, and before/after work to show off.
> - Reviews/recommendations are real customer quotes — fine for a testimonials section (first name only is safest).
> - Images live in `images/`. `profile` is usually the logo, `cover` the banner. Big landscape photos make the best hero images.
> - Raw text sections contain some Facebook interface noise ("Like", "Share", menu items) — ignore that.
